200.description: Returns the Pub/Sub subscription state for each configured Gmail application.

lastError.description: Last Pub/Sub related error for this app - either a setup error or an OAuth2 token renewal failure
lastError.title: PubSubSetupError

400.description: Invalid input - the path parameters, query arguments, or request payload did not pass validation. Also returned when the email server refused the request, in which case the response carries a code and the server response instead of a field list

fields.description: List of input fields that failed validation

message.example: "pageSize" must be less than or equal to 1000

key.description: Name of the input field that failed validation

path.description: Full path of the input field that failed validation. Same as key for a top-level field, dotted for a nested one

fields.title: ValidationErrorFields

details.description: Additional error details, if available. The email server response for a refused mailbox operation

info.description: Additional error details, if available. The email server response for a refused message operation

401.description: Authentication failed - the access token is missing, invalid, or was not accepted

403.description: Access denied - the access token does not grant permission for this operation (token scope, account, or IP address restriction)

requestedScope.description: The scope the operation needed, when the token does not carry it

requiredPermission.description: The permission grant the operation needed, when the token permissions do not include it

remoteAddress.description: The client IP address, when the token is restricted to other addresses

429.description: Rate limit exceeded - too many requests were made with this access token

ttl.description: Seconds until the rate limit window resets

500.description: Internal server error - an unexpected error occurred while processing the request
